items.title: George Russell — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: She introduced me to a man most people may not know, but, Gurdjieff.

ctx.x: You called her the heart and soul of Norway in your dedication. That’s very nice.
Yeah. She was a very strong woman. She introduced me to a man most people may not know, but, Gurdjieff. I don’t know if you’ve heard of Gurdjieff.
Tangerding? I saw a name that reminds me of. Is that Goetz? Or is that someone else? Gurdjieff, did you say?
